memo.summary: Halden makes precision instruments for water and emissions testing; the installed base drives a consumables stream that grows regardless of capex cycles.
memo.what_it_does: Makes precision instruments for water-quality and emissions testing, sold to utilities, environmental labs and industrial sites.

products.name: Aqualyzer probes
products.what: field instruments that measure dissolved metals and pH

products.name: Emiscan bench units
products.what: lab analysers for emissions compliance testing

products.name: Consumables
products.what: reagent cartridges and calibration standards, replaced quarterly

memo.how_it_earns: Consumables and service contracts now bring in more revenue than the instruments themselves, smoothing the cycle.
bear: A deep industrial recession cuts instrument sales first.
A cheaper imported probe could undercut the entry range.
Consumables growth could stall if utilities standardise on a rival format.
memo.bear_hardest: If a large customer certifies a competitor's cartridge format, the recurring stream resets.
gaps: Exact consumables margin is not disclosed.
Order backlog is reported only annually.

tv.summary: Halden makes precision instruments for water and emissions testing; the installed base drives a consumables stream that grows regardless of capex cycles.
tv.variant_view: The market prices it as a cyclical instrument maker; the consumables share of revenue is now the majority and makes the earnings far steadier than the multiple implies.
tv.assumptions: ["consumables revenue keeps compounding at ~8%","no large dilutive acquisition"]
tv.catalysts: Interim results in November; consumables attach-rate disclosure.
tv.risks: A deep industrial recession would cut instrument sales first.
tv.invalidation: Consumables revenue falls two quarters in a row.
tv.exit_conditions: Thesis invalidated, or the position reaches its target weight through price alone.
tv.reason_for_change: Tightened the invalidation condition after the interim update.
